changelog: - **Demo form on the MARKETING landing, filed into the right tenant by an explicit host→org mapping; org-level default lead owner** (#2569, #2580 item 3). New nullable `Organization.publicHost @unique` (set with `prisma/set-public-host.mjs`): a sessionless enquiry lands in the org that claims the request's exact hostname; an unmapped INTERNSHIP host keeps the default org; an unmapped MARKETING host (or a mapping to the other product) is a **closed form** — the landing says so and `POST /api/company-inquiry` answers 503 `form_unavailable`. The rule is pure and unit-tested (`src/lib/publicHostRule.ts`); the host-trust note in `src/lib/hostVertical.ts` records it as the second permitted use. The landing embeds `CompanyInquiryForm variant="marketing"` (`#demo`; `/for-companies` stays a 404 there): marketplaces instead of open roles, a separate unchecked product-news box stored as an unconfirmed **request** (`marketingOptInRequested` + its own wording version `marketingOptInTextVersion`; `marketingOptInConfirmedAt` stays NULL — no double opt-in yet, so nothing may be mailed on it), UTM parameters + referrer (origin + path only, `src/lib/inquiryAttribution.ts`), and the server stamps `consentTextVersion = PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION`, bumped to `2026-09-29` with a new privacy-notice section (EN/TR/DE) that names what these forms store; no IP is stored. The public response is `{ ok: true }` only, the same as the honeypot's, so it reveals nothing about existing staff, leads or accounts. The deploy log now reports public-host mappings and names any MARKETING org whose form is still closed (`set-public-host.mjs --list`, report only). The new-enquiry notification and e-mail now go **only to the target org's admins** (it used to reach every tenant's), by the same default-org rule as the list (`orgWhere()` in `src/lib/tenantFilter.ts`). `/admin/company-inquiries` and its PATCH/convert filter by the caller's tenant explicitly, and the nav link now follows the `companies` capability, so MARKETING admins get it as **Demo requests**. In a MARKETING org "convert" becomes **Add to pipeline**: Company + stand-in lead + first-stage funnel record through the #2562 writer (`src/lib/inquiryLead.ts`), no login or invitation, idempotent through a conditional claim on `convertedAt`. New setting `defaultLeadOwnerId` (`src/lib/leadOwner.ts`, MARKETING settings form, validated against the caller's org): a web request with a default owner lands on that owner's funnel by itself, otherwise it waits in the list marked **Unowned**; the hand-typed lead route takes an optional `ownerId`, then the default owner, then the typist. e2e `marketing-demo-form.spec.ts`; unit `public-host-org` + `inquiry-attribution`.

en: The marketing website now has a demo request form. Each request lands in your own organization with its campaign source and consent record, and goes straight onto the pipeline of the default lead owner you pick in Settings — or waits, marked unowned, under Demo requests until an admin adds it.
tr: Pazarlama web sitesinde artık bir demo talep formu var. Her talep, geldiği kampanya ve onay kaydıyla birlikte kendi kuruluşunuza düşer; Ayarlar’da seçtiğiniz varsayılan aday sahibinin hattına doğrudan eklenir — ya da bir yönetici ekleyene kadar Demo talepleri’nde sahipsiz olarak bekler.
de: Die Marketing-Website hat jetzt ein Formular für Demo-Anfragen. Jede Anfrage landet mit Kampagnenquelle und Einwilligungsnachweis in Ihrer eigenen Organisation und geht direkt in die Pipeline der Standard-Zuständigkeit, die Sie in den Einstellungen wählen — oder wartet unter Demo-Anfragen als „ohne Zuständige“, bis ein Admin sie übernimmt.
